title: Structured extraction with NativeOutput and an output validator
description: The model extracts a typed Deadline object constrained by NativeOutput, an output validator checks that the date has not passed, and Python computes the day count.

steps.description: Deadline defines event and target fields, and the Agent uses NativeOutput(Deadline) so Ollama constrains the reply to that JSON schema.
The @agent.output_validator function not_in_the_past checks that output.target is not before today and raises ModelRetry if it is.
After agent.run_sync returns the validated Deadline instance d, line 38 computes (d.target - date.today()).days in Python rather than asking the model to do arithmetic.
